Welcome

Simple comfort, on the way to everywhere.

Najuka Lodging sits just off the Mumbai–Goa Highway, with a calm river at the back door. Clean A/C and non A/C rooms, free Wi-Fi, tea and breakfast — and Tarkarli, Sindhudurg Fort and Devgad within easy reach.
